Name: Yandere Abigail
Author: bhallspawns
Description:
[b]Please be careful when using other mods in addition to this mod that may slightly alter or add, or completely change, Abigail's dialogues and events.
[/b]
This mod changes Abigail into a "Yandere". Included are her regular (with *slight* changes to some of her event dialogue depending on the choice of the player), her 1-year festivals, breakup & divorce + bouquet & pendant, and resort dialogues.

Downloads.Description:
